title: PODZO — AI-Powered Enterprise Logistics Execution & Siding Dispatch
heroHeadline: Autonomous siding dispatch, weighbridge tare/gross match, and Proof-of-Delivery across Order-to-Cash.

cards.title: Welcome to PODZO: Autonomous Logistics Execution
cards.botDialogue: Welcome! I'm your Lead Architect. In high-volume heavy industries, logistics bottlenecks kill cash flow. PODZO eliminates manual railcar and weighbridge reconciliation in real time.
bullets: Autonomous siding dispatch linked to active SAP Sales Orders
Computer vision weighbridge tare & gross weight verification
Deterministic 3-way match triggering instant MIRO settlement

cards.title: The Operational Bottleneck: Manual Siding & Paper PODs
cards.botDialogue: Before PODZO, plants faced rail congestion, days of manual slip verification, and costly billing disputes with transporters.
bullets: Manual railcar siding allocation causes congestion and rail demurrage penalties
Weighbridge paper slips and physical POD delivery notes take 4-7 days to verify into SAP
Discrepancies between dispatch gross weight and sales orders delay billing

cards.title: End-to-End Architectural Solution Flow
cards.botDialogue: Here is how PODZO closes the loop cleanly: the Sales Order in S/4HANA triggers siding reservation, automated vision checks the tare and gross weights, and tolerance logic posts directly to MIRO.

cards.title: Live Dispatch Control Tower
cards.botDialogue: This is the live PODZO Control Tower running on SAP Build Work Zone. Click on any hotspot to inspect live sales order dispatches, pending POD audits, and payload conversions.

cards.title: Automated 3-Step Execution Pipeline
cards.botDialogue: Notice how every step is clean core compliant. No custom tables are injected into the ERP core.

steps.title: Siding Allocation
steps.desc: Active S/4HANA Sales Order is allocated to an open railcar siding slot automatically.

steps.title: Weighbridge Vision OCR
steps.desc: Live optical camera extracts truck license, tare weight, and signed delivery stamp.

steps.title: Autonomous MIRO Post
steps.desc: Pre-configured tolerance threshold engine posts invoice directly to S/4HANA finance ledger.

cards.title: Enterprise Cloud Architecture
cards.botDialogue: PODZO runs on SAP BTP Cloud Foundry using Node.js CAP, connected to S/4HANA through Destination Service and Cloud Connector.

cards.title: Quantified Business ROI
cards.botDialogue: The financial impact is immediate: cycle time drops from 4 days to 30 seconds, and rail demurrage penalties are completely eliminated.

cards.title: Ready to Deploy PODZO?
cards.botDialogue: You can launch the live simulation right now, inspect the BTP deployment prerequisites, or export the executive solution brief.
